notes: Decision model, not a chat model: prefill-only pointer head over Qwen3.5-4B-Base; serves POST /v1/systemone (TypeSafe System One API) with calibrated choice/score/noul answers.

Served by the kev runtime via lm_launcher/kev_serve_local.py: kev.serve --run rejects this pack (merged backbone weights + adapter-mode head.pt fail Checkpoint.full()), so the shim loads per the artifact card's documented path and hands the model to kev.serve's Server/app unchanged. The runtime is not on PyPI, so mlx_server clones it into support/kev (KEV_REPO_DIR overrides).
This artifact is a community (non-official) merged+quantized conversion of jaredpalmer/kev-4b revision 139fdd94; head.pt (temperature 2.406) is copied unchanged from the canonical checkpoint.

Verified locally 2026-10-10: model.safetensors is 4,469,640,165 bytes, sha256 83adf34ef8f2433166225960d0f074def35d3de52449fa8861bc356398312d31 — matches upstream provenance.json exactly; head.pt sha256 dd633435998ecc751ac538717a3742e32149500fabf7d7276287dbf0693f347c matches the kev-4b model card.
Accuracy parity with bf16 is reported on-Mac across five dev suites (decision-v7 0.873 acc / ECE 0.010); process footprint ~6.6GB while scoring.
kev-4b validated context is 8192 tokens (accuracy degrades beyond); the server accepts states up to 65536 tokens and refuses longer with 422.
Unofficial conversion caveat: built for the Qualm app; the canonical bf16 path is 'kev.serve --run jaredpalmer/kev-4b' if parity issues appear.
